title: Artifact Refiner Model Policy
description: Shape of .kbd-orchestrator/project.json -> model_policy. Drives phase-tiered inference routing across endpoints (host harness, openai-proxy, etc.).
$comment: prefer_model values are upstream-proxy aliases (e.g., 'gpt-5.4-mini' resolved by openai-proxy), not canonical OpenAI/Anthropic API model IDs. If the proxy renames a catalog entry, prefer_model strings must be updated accordingly.

default_endpoint.description: Endpoint id used when a phase has no prefer_endpoint.

phases.description: Per-phase tier + endpoint/model preferences. Phase names follow refiner-<verb> (refiner-iterate, refiner-evaluate, refiner-finalize).

tier.description: Capability class. Mechanical phases use 'small'; evaluation/reasoning use 'medium' or 'frontier'.

prefer_endpoint.description: Preferred endpoint id (must match a key in endpoints). Falls back to default_endpoint when the preferred endpoint is unhealthy.

prefer_model.description: Preferred model alias on the preferred endpoint. Proxy-mediated alias, not a canonical API id.

endpoints.description: Endpoint registry. Each entry describes how to reach a model provider.

via.description: Inference proxied through whatever LLM harness hosts the refiner (Claude Code, Codex CLI, etc.). No external service contract.

base_url.description: Base URL for the proxy's OpenAI-compatible /v1 surface.

auth_mode.description: Primary auth path. chatgpt_oauth uses 'codex login' subscription credentials; openai_api_key uses OPENAI_API_KEY env var.

fallback_auth.description: Optional fallback auth mode if the primary is unavailable.

health_probe.description: URL the health-probe utility hits to determine readiness. Typically <base_url-without-/v1>/health.
